title: Funeral and brass bands: Manuel Perez, Chris Kelly, Excelsior
summary: He played brass bands under Manuel Perez and Chris Kelly, and parades while a student of Tio.

blocks.x: brass bands you play with many of them brass bands too which ones well well here in new orleans in new
ones yeah well i played with uh manuel perez old man joey moret played with him while chris he had a band funeral band chris kelly chris kelly had a funeral band manu perez

All he'd do mostly was parade. Right off Alexander and I was the youngest kids in the band. Old man George and Rhett would play with him. The Excelsior band would play there. You see I was taking lessons with Teo. Teo was a very fine fellow with me. He did everything to help him. Now when he would have a job with Piron, and he'd be tired playing at night, and he'd have a funeral, he'd send me by me being his scholar. You understand what I mean? That's where I got band training.
You ever played with the Onward band?
The Excelsior. You never played with the Onward?
The Onward band, but that was Emmanuel Perez.
